claims.text: $106.3M of public money awarded plus what others promised to put in beside it: the standfirst's 'the two added together are the $106.3 million the region reports as secured', the third hero stat card under the key 'The two added together', the meta description and the closer's 'every dollar of the $106.3 million, awarded and promised, has a line on it'. IT IS NO LONGER THE HEADLINE NUMBER. Until 2026-08-29 the H1 printed $106 million one line above a standfirst saying governments awarded $85.3 million, so a reader met a contradiction and then four totals before any explanation. The H1 now prints the awarded money and the standfirst reaches the total in its next sentence.

claims.text: $85.3M awarded by government, plus $21.0M partners promised to add beside it, the match and cost share. The match is labelled 'promised, not awarded' on its own card because it is money others agreed to put in, not government money and not money spent, and reading it as awarded is what the old $106 million headline invited.

claims.text: THE VERIFICATION CLAIM, ITSELF VERIFIED.
